verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature. Nothing shows a way to export learnings, review history, dashboard metrics or account data in open formats. The closest items are adjacent: configuration kept as `.coderabbit.yaml` in your own repo, the `@coderabbitai configuration` command that prints resolved config as YAML, and data-retention opt-out controls. These cover config portability and deletion, not exporting all of your data before leaving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
